title: Energy Vault to supply batteries, PCS for 1.25-GW Texas power project
summary: Energy Vault will supply battery storage and power systems for a 1.25-GW power project at a Texas data center, advancing renewable energy solutions.
body_markdown: Energy Vault Holdings Inc (NYSE:NRGV) has signed an agreement to supply battery storage systems, grid-forming power conversion systems (PCS) and control software for an initial 1.25-GW integrated power infrastructure deployment for a hyperscaler data centre customer in Texas.
